i_files_open.how: openCARP text format (.pts um, .elem Tt with tag, .lon), read with numpy / pandas; meshtool reads carp_txt natively

estimate_host_alone.basis: total process memory of the v5.1 lead-field solve (2 x 3.0 GB) scaled by nodes or by elements

estimate_with_pilot_heart (host heart re.basis: total process memory of the v5.1 lead-field solve (2 x 3.0 GB) scaled by nodes or by elements

ii_size_and_memory.note: smaller than the v5.1 heart-torso mesh in nodes; a measured subset run is still due before the solve (15.1)

iii_host_heart_axes.inputs_present: LV wall 35, RV wall 34, LV / RV blood pools 25 / 24, valves 16-19: the v5.1 Laplace set-up (apex patch, valve rims, endocardium, epicardium) can be built
iii_host_heart_axes.reason_not_run: item (iv) already fails, so the arm is not run

iv_electrode_landmarks.bones: one tag (3) for the whole skeleton, and the skeleton is one connected component, so single bones are told apart only by position
iv_electrode_landmarks.intercostal_spaces: ribs present laterally from the top cut to about z -265 mm; rib gaps would have to be read by position
iv_electrode_landmarks.clavicles: the mesh is cut at z +75 mm through the lung apices; clavicles not separable from ribs and scapulae by tag
iv_electrode_landmarks.costal_margin: lower anterior rib border near z -165 to -205 mm (by position)

iliac_crest.reason: the mesh ends at z -306 mm; below z -245 mm the bone narrows to the spine (x -31 to +54 mm in the last slab): no iliac wing is in the mesh

A35_KCL.A35_verdict: not run: check (iv) fails (no iliac crest in the host mesh, so the LL electrode cannot be placed by the Kligfield landmark rule; the clavicles are not identifiable either)

record.title: Tetrahedral meshes of male human torso and heart

i_readable.how: VTK XML UnstructuredGrid, header_type UInt64, inline base64 "binary" arrays, no compressor: parsed with the Python standard library (xml text, base64, struct); the full Material array (133,089,852 characters) was fetched and decoded by HTTP range request; meshtool VTU input not tried

estimate_torso_alone.basis: total process memory of the v5.1 lead-field solve (2 x 3.0 GB) scaled by nodes or by elements

ii_size_and_memory.note: about twice the v5.1 heart-torso mesh in cells and nodes before the pilot heart is added; the estimate exceeds WSL's 7.7 GB under either scaling

iii_skeletal_muscle_fibres.reading: Torso.vtu holds no skeletal-muscle cells: Material 8 (Muscles_Skeleton) is listed in material.tab but absent from the mesh (its Material range is 2-62 and no cell is 8), so there is no muscle to give conductivities or fibres to

A36_Moss.A36_verdict: not run: Torso.vtu contains no skeletal muscle (Material 8 absent), and check (ii) fails (the memory estimate for the torso alone exceeds the 7.7 GB single-process budget)
